title: 76 - Funeral
summary: [[character:bob-replicant|Bob]] attends [[character:diana]]'s burial through [[technology:charlie]]. She died peacefully the night before. [[character:archimedes]], [[character:buster]], [[character:rosa]], [[character:pete-deltan]] and other relatives grieve. The family leaves 31 flowers with Diana and shields the grave from scavengers with stone slabs. Overcome, Bob briefly retreats into [[technology:vr|VR]], leaving Charlie on autonomous control until he returns. He estimates that Archimedes is around seventy and slightly older than [[character:moses]] was when he died. Bob expects to attend another funeral soon and vows it will be his last.

introducing.name: Rosa
introducing.description: A Deltan of [[location:delta-eridani-4|Eden]], a child of [[character:archimedes]] and a sibling of [[character:buster]] and Pete. Mourns with Archimedes and the other children at [[character:diana]]'s burial, where each child lays a white flower in the grave.

introducing.name: Pete
introducing.description: A Deltan of [[location:delta-eridani-4|Eden]], a child of [[character:archimedes]] and a sibling of [[character:buster]] and [[character:rosa]]. Not the Bob clone Pete. Mourns with Archimedes and the other children at [[character:diana]]'s burial.

updates.current_state: Shaken by Diana's burial, he takes a moment to compose himself. Seeing how old Archimedes has grown, he expects another funeral soon and vows it will be the last one he attends.
He is grieving Diana's death alongside his children. Bob estimates that he is around seventy, slightly older than Moses was when he died.
She died peacefully the night before her family buried her.
